benchmark_mujoco_warp: benchmark MuJoCo Warp simulation performance on an MJCF model file with configurable parallel worlds
test_step_function: test the mujoco_warp step function benchmark on an MJCF model with specified number of parallel worlds
measure_solver_iterations: measure solver iteration statistics across rollout steps with configurable bucket summaries
profile_memory_usage: profile GPU memory usage of MuJoCo Warp model and data structures during simulation
run_render_benchmark: run the render function benchmark on an MJCF model with BVH refit and GPU rendering
